content.comment_body: How can I configure [product_name] to send data over the Internet port in less than 90 ms?

Hello [user_name], For improving communication speed, keep in mind: 1. Cycle Time: The program cycle time for [product_name] is crucial and includes reading inputs, processing logic, and output actions. Functions typically operate with cycle times under 0.1 ms ([document]). 2. TCP Connection and Flow Control: The TCP protocol’s flow control can impact response times. Sending data faster than the receiver can process may reduce the TCP window size and result in higher latency ([document]). 3. Ethernet Connection Setup: Efficient configuration of Ethernet connections in [product_name] is important. Use appropriate network blocks and optimize settings for fast data transfer ([document]). Optimizing the cycle time and managing TCP connections properly can help achieve faster data transfer via the Internet port. Hope this helps to increase your communication speed. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned with latency issues when setting up data transmission over the Internet using [product_name]. They seek ways to achieve communication times below 90 ms. Users express a need for clear guidance on optimizing parameters and managing protocol behavior to successfully minimize communication delays.
